description: Several calendars overlaid on one week in the Svelte 5 scheduler: Work, Personal, Family and Holidays, each colour-coded from a legend you can toggle, through calendars and calendarField. Turning a calendar off hides its events across every view, and an event takes its calendar's colour unless it sets its own; the same rows power the Table.

faq.question: How is an event assigned to a calendar?
faq.answer: calendarField names the row field holding the calendar id, and calendars lists each id with a title and colour; the legend renders from that list.

faq.question: How does the toggle hide events?
faq.answer: Each calendar has a visible flag the legend flips; the scheduler filters events whose calendar is hidden in every view without touching the rows.

faq.question: Can an event override its colour?
faq.answer: Yes. An event with its own colour keeps it; otherwise the calendar's colour from the calendars list applies through calendarField.
